example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাড়ির উঠোন দেখে মনে হয় জান্নাতুল ফিরদৌস।
সেই স্থানটি ছিল জান্নাতুল ফিরদৌসের মতো শান্তিময়।
example_sentences_in_english: Her garden looks like Jannatul Firdaus.
That place was as peaceful as the highest paradise.
history: Derived from Islamic tradition in the Quran, referring to the uppermost level of Jannah (paradise) promised to the righteous.
note: This idiom is borrowed from Arabic and commonly used in Bengali Muslim contexts to denote ultimate bliss or perfection.
